svg.title: Three principles of Mell
svg.desc: Governed memory: every fact has a source and a state, nothing changes silently. Permission-gated actions: the model proposes, deterministic code decides. Local and Turkish-first: local models, chosen by Turkish evaluation; cloud is opt-in.

g.text: Every fact keeps its source and state.
Inspect, export or delete all of it.
Untrusted content limits what a turn
may do. Approvals bind to exact targets.
Every step lands in an audit log.
Local models on your own GPU,
Cloud is opt-in, filtered and capped.
